xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-1254: Set up Tailscale from Overdeck: install, sign in, Serve HTTPS, peer discovery

plan.title: Set up Tailscale from Overdeck: install, sign in, Serve HTTPS, peer discovery
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

references.label: Parent PRD PAN-2350 rev 5 (W-TS1, FR-19, D-17)

narratives.Problem: Overdeck Anywhere encourages Tailscale as the route between machines (parent PRD D-17), but Overdeck has no Tailscale code: the operator must install, sign in, configure Serve HTTPS and protect the dashboard by hand, and nothing shows which tailnet machines run Overdeck. Turning on Tailscale Serve by hand today also opens a root-session hole while dashboard.require_token_mint is off.
narratives.Proposal: Add src/lib/tailscale/ (CLI runner and state reader with a derived next step, per-platform install plan, userspace tailscaled under a systemd user unit, sign-in URL capture, protected Serve HTTPS that first turns on require_token_mint and trusts the Serve origin, and descriptor-probe peer discovery). Expose it through GET/POST /api/tailscale/* routes (root session or internal token for mutations), a Settings → Anywhere 'Set up Tailscale' dialog that runs elevated steps in a visible terminal pane via POST /api/terminals, an Overdeck-peers panel, a phone-app QR, an Anywhere status row plus a serve-unprotected problem, and `pan tailscale status|setup`. Document it in configuration/tailscale.mdx, cli/tailscale.mdx and a Tailscale-first remote-access.mdx. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-1254.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Advertising tailnet or Serve endpoints in the descriptor, learned routes, machine links, or any Link action (W-LINK1/W-LINK2, #4645)
- Tailscale Funnel or webhook delivery (#4648)
- The old body's /endpoints panel, AdvertisedEndpoint registry, per-workspace Serve, or pan up/pan down Serve lifecycle hooks
- Turning Serve off, or replacing another program's Serve handler on 443
- Asking for, storing, logging or passing an administrator password
- Driving the Windows Tailscale client from WSL2, or a native-Windows flow beyond showing the winget command
- Automating loginctl enable-linger for the userspace unit
- Tailscale OAuth clients or auth keys for unattended join (W-FLY2)
- A pan-tailscale wrapper skill
- An Effect port of t3code's tailscale module
- Raising any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt row

autoDecisions.summary: Write new code as plain async functions in src/lib/tailscale/, not an Effect port of t3code's module
autoDecisions.rationale: The repo's one-variant rule (docs/EFFECT-BRIDGING.md) forbids an Effect wrapper over Promise code; the issue body's Effect design is marked as history.

autoDecisions.summary: Turning on Serve first sets dashboard.require_token_mint true and trusts the Serve URL origin
autoDecisions.rationale: Parent PRD 'Known blockers': Serve with require_token_mint false lets every tailnet visitor mint the root session; W-SEC4 (#4645) that automates this has not shipped, so the flow must not open the hole.

autoDecisions.summary: pan tailscale setup turns on Serve through the running dashboard, never by writing config files itself
autoDecisions.rationale: The token-mint and trusted-origin caches live in the server process; a direct file write would leave the running server unprotected until restart.

autoDecisions.summary: POST /api/tailscale/* accept only the root session and the internal token
autoDecisions.rationale: Same precedent as POST /api/pairing/credentials (pairing.ts:74-77); a paired device must not change this machine's network exposure.

autoDecisions.summary: Panes reuse the existing POST /api/terminals route; the status response supplies the commands
autoDecisions.rationale: No new tmux code, and the route already attaches on Herdr hosts via the tmux fallback in resolveTerminalAttachTarget.

autoDecisions.summary: Discovery lists Overdeck peers without a Link action
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says linking needs #4645 (W-LINK1); until then discovery lists peers only.

autoDecisions.summary: Userspace mode is an operator choice on Linux and automatic when sudo is not on PATH, run as the systemd user unit overdeck-tailscaled.service
autoDecisions.rationale: D-17 implementation checkpoint names userspace mode for Linux without sudo; Overdeck already manages systemd user units (src/lib/systemd.ts).

autoDecisions.summary: No pan up/pan down Serve lifecycle and never `tailscale serve off`
autoDecisions.rationale: --bg persists Serve inside tailscaled; Overdeck must not clobber other programs' Serve config.

autoDecisions.summary: Set plan.metadata.sizeJustification instead of creating sibling issues
autoDecisions.rationale: This issue is already the W-TS1 leaf of the operator's #2350 decomposition; the lint counts each doc file as its own subsystem, and a CLI/UI split would be horizontal layering.

autoDecisions.summary: Extract QrImage once into Settings/anywhere/QrImage.tsx and leave OpenOnScreenTab's copy alone
autoDecisions.rationale: The phone QR would be the third copy; surgical-change rule keeps the unrelated conversation copy untouched.

metadata.sizeJustification: PAN-1254 is already the decomposed W-TS1 leaf of epic #2350 (operator's revision-5 issue disposition assigns all of W-TS1 here). The projected surface counts ~45 files and 8 two-segment subsystems mainly because every top-level doc file (configuration/tailscale.mdx, configuration/remote-access.mdx, cli/tailscale.mdx, docs.json) and package.json count as separate subsystems, and each lib module carries its own test file. Splitting CLI from UI would be the horizontal layering the swarm contract rejects; the 20 items are each small, vertical and independently reviewable.

items.title: Tailscale CLI runner and state reader in src/lib/tailscale

narrative.Action: PRD W-1. Create src/lib/tailscale/cli.ts (resolveTailscaleCli per D-7, runTailscale with AbortController+setTimeout timeouts per NFR-3, path helpers tailscaleHome/userspaceSocketPath/userspaceBinDir) and src/lib/tailscale/state.ts (TailscaleState, pure parseTailscaleStatus, parseServeStatus, computeNextStep implementing the D-8 table (including the protect row and three-state operator per D-6), and readTailscaleState running version/status --json/serve status --json/debug prefs in parallel, memoized for 3 s so the 30 s Anywhere status refetch and concurrent routes do not spawn a process per request). Plain async functions modeled on src/lib/sageox/probe.ts; no Effect wrapper (D-1); no sync child processes (NFR-2). Tests in tests/unit/lib/tailscale/{cli,state}.test.ts with fake timers.

items.title: Given fixtures for each row of PRD D-8, computeNextStep returns install, start-daemon, operator, login, enable-https, serve, protect and ready respectively, and returns login (not operator) when operator is unknown because debug prefs failed
Given ${OVERDECK_HOME}/tailscale/bin/tailscale exists, resolveTailscaleCli returns mode 'userspace' with baseArgs ['--socket=<home>/tailscale/tailscaled.sock'] even when tailscale is also on PATH
Given a child that never exits, runTailscale returns { ok: false, timedOut: true } after 1500 ms advanced with vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync
Given no tailscale binary anywhere, readTailscaleState resolves (never rejects) with installed false and nextStep 'install'

parseServeStatus returns proxiesDashboard true for Web['<name>:443'].Handlers['/'].Proxy 'http://127.0.0.1:3011', and returns otherHandlerOn443 true for a proxy to another port, a TCP['443'] TCPForward entry, and an extra web mount besides '/'
Per-platform Tailscale install plan

narrative.Action: PRD W-2 and D-9. Create src/lib/tailscale/installer.ts exporting the InstallPlan union, pure installPlan(input) implementing every D-9 row, operatorCommand(username) (null for a name failing /^[a-z_][a-z0-9_.-]*\$?$/i), and resolveInstallPlan({ userspace }) gathering detectPlatform() (src/lib/platform.ts), uid, os.userInfo().username and an async PATH scan for sudo/brew with fs.promises.access(X_OK). No elevation happens here; commands are strings only (NFR-1).

items.title: Given platform linux, sudo on PATH and userspace false, installPlan returns { kind: 'pane', command: 'curl -fsSL https://tailscale.com/install.sh | sh && sudo tailscale set --operator=<user>' }
Given platform linux with no sudo on PATH, or userspace true, installPlan returns { kind: 'userspace' }

Given platform darwin with brew on PATH, installPlan returns a pane command 'brew install --cask tailscale-app && open -a Tailscale'; without brew it returns a manual plan with url https://pkgs.tailscale.com/stable/#macos
Given platform wsl or win32, installPlan returns kind 'manual' and win32 includes command 'winget install tailscale.tailscale'
Given username 'bad name;rm', operatorCommand returns null and installPlan on linux falls back to the manual plan
Userspace tailscaled install under a systemd user unit (D-17 checkpoint)

metadata.parallelSafeReason: Owns userspace.ts and its test; installer.ts is touched only in the C-1 fallback and ts-install-plan precedes it by edge.

narrative.Action: PRD W-3, D-10, C-1, C-2. Create src/lib/tailscale/userspace.ts: renderTailscaledUnit(home) (exact D-10 unit text), tarballArch(nodeArch), installUserspaceTailscale(deps) (pkgs.tailscale.com/stable/?mode=json -> Tarballs[arch] -> download -> sha256 check -> async tar extract -> copy tailscale+tailscaled into ${OVERDECK_HOME}/tailscale/bin 0755 -> installUserUnit + enableUserUnitNow from src/lib/systemd.ts -> wait up to 10 s for the socket), and restartUserspaceDaemon(). Every failure returns { ok: false, reason, message, fallbackCommand } where fallbackCommand is the install.sh line. Then perform checkpoint C-1 live: on a Linux host, install in userspace mode, sign in, and from another tailnet device curl http://<tailnet-ip>:<api_port>/api/environment and https://<MagicDNS>/api/environment; paste commands and output into the PR body. If inbound fails, OR the live check cannot be run because no tailnet sign-in, auth key or second tailnet device is available, apply the C-1 fallback: installPlan stops returning 'userspace' (Linux without sudo gets the manual plan with the install.sh command), and the PR body records why. Never fabricate evidence. Also pan tell flywheel-orchestrator so the operator can run the live check later and re-enable userspace.

items.title: renderTailscaledUnit('/h') produces ExecStart=/h/tailscale/bin/tailscaled --tun=userspace-networking --statedir=/h/tailscale/state --socket=/h/tailscale/tailscaled.sock --outbound-http-proxy-listen=127.0.0.1:1055 and WantedBy=default.target
Given systemdUserAvailable() false, installUserspaceTailscale returns { ok: false, reason: 'no-systemd' } with fallbackCommand 'curl -fsSL https://tailscale.com/install.sh | sh' and downloads nothing
Given a downloaded tarball whose sha256 differs from the published .sha256, installUserspaceTailscale returns reason 'checksum-mismatch' and writes no binary to bin/
Given the socket never appears, installUserspaceTailscale returns reason 'daemon-timeout' after 10 s advanced with fake timers

Live checkpoint C-1: the PR body shows curl output from a second tailnet device returning this machine's environmentId at http://<tailnet-ip>:<api_port>/api/environment, or, when inbound fails or the check cannot be run, the C-1 fallback applies and installPlan returns the manual plan for Linux without sudo, with the reason recorded in the PR body
Tailscale sign-in URL capture

narrative.Action: PRD W-4, D-11. Create src/lib/tailscale/login.ts exporting startTailscaleLogin(state, deps): spawn `login` (or `up` when backend is Stopped) with piped output via node:child_process spawn, resolve with the first /https:\/\/\S+/ within 15 s, keep the child alive for the sign-in, kill it after 10 minutes, share one pending child per process, and map access-denied stderr (D-6) to { error: 'access-denied' } (this is how an unknown operator is resolved).

items.title: Given a fake child that writes 'To authenticate, visit:\n\thttps://login.tailscale.com/a/abc' to stderr, startTailscaleLogin resolves { authUrl: 'https://login.tailscale.com/a/abc' }
Given no URL within 15 s (fake timers), startTailscaleLogin resolves { error: 'timeout' } and kills the child
Given stderr 'Access denied: prefs write access denied', startTailscaleLogin resolves { error: 'access-denied' }
Given two concurrent calls, spawn is called once and both callers receive the same authUrl
Given backend state 'Stopped', the spawned args are ['up'] and an exit 0 with no URL resolves { authUrl: null }
Protected Tailscale Serve HTTPS: token mint, trusted origin, serve, self-check

expected_outputs: lint:file-size reports no file over its allowed count
metadata.parallelSafeReason: Owns serve.ts, its test, and one new function in settings-api.ts that no other item touches.

narrative.Action: PRD W-5, D-2, D-12, NFR-5, C-4. Add exported saveRequireTokenMint() beside saveDesignLanguage in src/lib/settings-api.ts (one runSettingsWriteSerialized turn using saveSettingsApiPromiseUnlocked; stay under the 1508-line allowlist cap, else use the PRD's require-token-mint.ts fallback; never raise the allowlist). Create src/lib/tailscale/serve.ts exporting enableTailscaleServe(deps) returning the PRD ServeResult union, in the exact order: read state, refuse not-running / https-disabled (adminUrl https://login.tailscale.com/admin/dns) / foreign-handler / old-version (<1.52), saveRequireTokenMint(), addSavedTrustedOrigin('https://<MagicDNS>', alreadyTrusted), run `serve --bg --https=443 http://127.0.0.1:<port>` unless already proxying (changed:false), then 15 s self-check of https://<MagicDNS>/api/environment against ensureEnvironmentIdentity() (skipped in userspace mode). Never run `serve ... off`.

items.title: Given a Running tailnet with HTTPS certs, enableTailscaleServe calls saveRequireTokenMint and addSavedTrustedOrigin('https://desk.tailnet.ts.net') before the serve command, asserted by injected-dep call order
Given the serve command exits non-zero, enableTailscaleServe returns { ok: false, reason: 'serve-failed' } and require_token_mint remains written as true
Given serve status already proxies 443 to another local port, enableTailscaleServe returns reason 'foreign-handler' and never runs a serve command
Given Serve already proxies to the dashboard port, a second call returns { ok: true, changed: false } without running the serve command
Given CertDomains is empty, enableTailscaleServe returns reason 'https-disabled' with adminUrl 'https://login.tailscale.com/admin/dns' and writes no config
Tailnet peer discovery by descriptor probe

narrative.Action: PRD W-6, D-13. Create src/lib/tailscale/peers.ts exporting discoverTailnetPeers(state, { port, selfEnvironmentId }, deps): for each online peer probe https://<dnsName>/api/environment and http://<ipv4>:<port>/api/environment in parallel with 2.5 s AbortController timeouts (max 16 concurrent), decode with Schema.decodeUnknownSync(EnvironmentDescriptor) from @overdeck/contracts, drop self, return TailnetPeer[]. In userspace mode send only the http candidate through 127.0.0.1:1055 as an absolute-form node:http request.

items.title: Given an online peer whose http candidate returns a valid descriptor, discoverTailnetPeers returns that peer with overdeck.environmentId, label, serverVersion and url set
Given a peer that never answers, the result for that peer has overdeck null after 2500 ms advanced with fake timers
Given a descriptor whose environmentId equals selfEnvironmentId, that peer is omitted from the result
Given an offline peer, no probe is sent and the peer is returned with overdeck null
Given mode 'userspace', no https probe is sent and the http probe goes through the injected proxy request dep

Human output lists mode, version, backend, MagicDNS name, login, HTTPS certs, Serve URL or off, next step with remedy, and Overdeck peers; --json prints { state, peers }.

items.title: Given readTailscaleState reports not installed, `pan tailscale status` prints 'Tailscale is not installed. Run `pan tailscale setup`.' and exits 0
Given a ready state with one Overdeck peer, `pan tailscale status --json` prints JSON with state.nextStep 'ready' and a peers array of length 1
`pan tailscale --help` lists the status subcommand after a build (node dist/cli/index.js tailscale --help exits 0)
GET /api/tailscale/status route

items.title: GET /api/tailscale/status with a root session returns 200 with state.nextStep, install.kind, operatorCommand and port fields and Cache-Control no-store

npx vitest run tests/unit/lib/overdeck/no-loss-matrix.test.ts passes with the new route present
POST userspace, login and serve routes with root-only auth

narrative.Action: PRD W-9, D-4. In src/dashboard/server/routes/tailscale.ts add POST /api/tailscale/userspace, POST /api/tailscale/login and POST /api/tailscale/serve. Each runs rejectUnsafeDashboardMutationRequest, then refuses any credential kind other than root-session or internal-token with 403 { error: 'Only this machine can change Tailscale settings.' }. Serve passes getTrustedOrigins() as alreadyTrusted and calls invalidateTrustedOriginsCache() after every call whatever the result (critique finding 3); emits an activity entry when changed. Status codes per PRD W-9. Add three WRITE rows to no-loss-matrix.ts.

items.title: POST /api/tailscale/serve with a paired-device credential returns 403 and the serve lib is never called; the same holds for /login and /userspace
POST /api/tailscale/serve with the internal token and a mocked ok result returns 200 and invalidateTrustedOriginsCache is called once
POST /api/tailscale/serve with a mocked { ok: false, reason: 'self-check-failed' } returns 409 with the reason in the body and still calls invalidateTrustedOriginsCache once
POST /api/tailscale/login with a mocked access-denied result returns 409 { nextStep: 'operator' }
GET /api/tailscale/peers route

metadata.acJustification: A read-only route over an already-tested lib; two ACs cover the success path and the not-running short-circuit.

narrative.Action: PRD W-10. In src/dashboard/server/routes/tailscale.ts add GET /api/tailscale/peers returning { peers: TailnetPeer[] } from discoverTailnetPeers (empty when backend is not Running), guarded by rejectUnauthorizedDashboardRequest, no-store. Add the AGGREGATE row to no-loss-matrix.ts.

items.title: GET /api/tailscale/peers with a root session and a mocked Running state returns 200 { peers } with the mocked peer list
GET /api/tailscale/peers when backend state is NeedsLogin returns 200 { peers: [] } without calling discoverTailnetPeers
pan tailscale setup [--userspace]

metadata.acJustification: The setup command walks every next step; six ACs check one step transition each.

narrative.Action: PRD W-11, D-3. Add `tailscale setup [--userspace]` to src/cli/commands/tailscale.ts: loop at most 8 times over readTailscaleState().nextStep, running pane commands with spawn('sh', ['-c', cmd], { stdio: 'inherit' }) so the operator types sudo passwords in their own terminal, installUserspaceTailscale for userspace, startTailscaleLogin then 2 s polling up to 10 minutes for login, a login access-denied result runs the operator command then retries login once, and callDashboard('/api/tailscale/serve', { method: 'POST', body: {} }) for both serve and protect (dashboard unreachable => 'Overdeck dashboard is not running; start it with `pan up`.' exit 1). A step that does not change nextStep prints its remedy and exits 1.

items.title: Given state sequence install(pane) -> operator -> login -> serve -> ready, setup runs the pane command and operator command with stdio 'inherit', prints the sign-in URL, POSTs /api/tailscale/serve, prints the Serve URL and exits 0
Given the serve step and an unreachable dashboard, setup prints 'Overdeck dashboard is not running; start it with `pan up`.' and exits 1
Given nextStep 'enable-https', setup prints the https://login.tailscale.com/admin/dns instruction and exits 1
Given a step whose action leaves nextStep unchanged, setup exits 1 after one retry instead of looping
Given --userspace on linux, setup calls installUserspaceTailscale and never spawns sudo
Given nextStep 'protect' then 'ready', setup POSTs /api/tailscale/serve once and exits 0
Anywhere status: Tailscale row and serve-unprotected problem

Add AnywhereStatus.tailscale { nextStep | 'not-installed', serveUrl, magicDnsName } read in buildAnywhereStatus (src/dashboard/server/routes/anywhere.ts) via readTailscaleState; add action { kind: 'tailscale-setup' } and problem 'tailscale-serve-unprotected' to src/lib/remote-access/anywhere-status.ts (computeAnywhereProblems gains tailscaleServeOn and requireTokenMint inputs); mirror the unions in anywhereApi.ts; AnywhereStatusCard renders a Tailscale row and a 'Protect the dashboard' fix button for the new action.

Given tailscaleServeOn true and requireTokenMint true, computeAnywhereProblems returns no tailscale problem
GET /api/anywhere/status returns a tailscale object with nextStep 'not-installed' when no tailscale binary is resolvable
AnywhereStatusCard renders a 'Tailscale' row reading 'Ready (https://desk.tailnet.ts.net)' for a ready status and a 'Protect the dashboard' button for the new problem
Keep require_token_mint on while Tailscale Serve forwards to this dashboard

narrative.Action: PRD W-18 (critique finding 1). Create src/lib/tailscale/token-mint-guard.ts exporting keepTokenMintWhileServing(settings, deps): unchanged when settings.dashboard?.require_token_mint !== false (no Tailscale call); otherwise read readTailscaleState via dynamic import('./state.js') and, when Serve proxies this dashboard, return a copy with require_token_mint true and console.warn. items.title: Given Serve proxies this dashboard and a stale settings save with dashboard.require_token_mint false, keepTokenMintWhileServing returns settings with require_token_mint true
Given Serve is off, a save with require_token_mint false persists false

Settings → Anywhere 'Set up Tailscale' dialog with pane install, sign-in and Serve

metadata.acJustification: The dialog is the single UI surface for five setup steps plus the root-only visibility rule; each AC checks one observable step.
metadata.parallelSafeReason: Owns the dialog, tailscaleApi.ts and the AnywhereSection button; later frontend items that share AnywhereSection.tsx, TailscaleSetupDialog.tsx and package.json are ordered after it by edges.
